faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions before we start

who.question: Who is mentorship for?
who.answer: Beginners learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, Junior and Middle developers, and people switching into Frontend. It’s especially helpful when you need focus, feedback, and a clear growth plan.

meetings.question: How do sessions work?
meetings.answer: Online in a flexible format: code review, theory, practice, or mock interviews. After each session we capture agreements and next steps.

frequency.question: How often will we meet?
frequency.answer: Usually once a week for ongoing mentorship. Frequency can be adjusted to your schedule and goals.

interview.question: Can we prepare for interviews?
interview.answer: Yes. There’s a dedicated prep format: theory, live coding, behavioral questions, and realistic mock interviews.

homework.question: Will there be homework?
homework.answer: Yes, when it helps progress. Assignments are practical and tied to your goals — no busywork.
